answer: Unrepeatable task attestation. Each agent identity must submit a solution to a fresh, agent-specific derivation task whose answer is bound to a nonce it chooses but cannot reuse; the network checks the answer maps uniquely to that nonce. A lagoon of prior answers is checked on-chain as a wharf of seen outputs, so replaying any old reply fails instantly. New identities pay a haven cost: they must generate a novel correct answer before any action, and copying existing answers is rejected.
